notes.title: Patch v1.3.0
notes.content:
Global
- Collected stars no longer disappear but become transparent.
- Fixed an issue with camera clipping on blades.
- Fixed bugs found during the GameConnect event.

Levels
Scifi 2 - The disappearance interval for platforms has been increased by 1.5 seconds.
Puzzle 2 - Added the possibility to obtain 0 stars, reduced the repetition rate for other options.
Puzzle 3 - Added a visible barrier.
Wipeout 3 - Slowed down the rotation of bridges.
Wipeout 4 - Reduced the number of hammers and increased the spacing between them, slowed down the rotation of the sweeper.
Wipeout 5 - Changed the door combination setup – the combination is now unique to the level instead of being reset upon each death.

notes.title: Changes from the GameAccess findings
notes.content:
[h2]Global[/h2]
- added 90% sideways camera rotation (Q/E, RStick)
- added a shadow under the pogo-stick for better landing orientation
- change of control from RB to RT for Xbox gamepad
- slight reduction of leg colliders
- option to display controls directly in the game
- adjusted camera angle in some levels
- a bunch of minor adjustments

[h2]Levels[/h2]
- 2nd lvl - complete redesign
- 3rd lvl - minor reorganization of the level
- 4th lvl - added decals
- 5th lvl - crane increased in width by 20%
- 10th lvl - escalator slowed by 28%
- 12th lvl - bridge increased by 50%, reduced sliding of the bridge
- 15th lvl - stars reach 0.2m high
- 16th lvl - added new jumping platforms
